title: NDC-2646 — validation rules on the QA module (API, CRM Admin A, 28 Oct 2026)
lines: Rule "QA number must be 10 or less" = criteria {op: gt, field: qa_num, value: 10}, active
Create with QA Number 50  -> 422 RECORD_VALIDATION_FAILED / VALIDATION_RULE_FAILED "QA number must be 10 or less"
Rule with condition "garbage ((( not an expression" -> 422 VALIDATION_RULE_INVALID
Pick-list rule {eq qa_pick Blue}: create with Blue -> 422 "Blue is not allowed" (NDC-2536 item 2)
Same rule through the ingest API (mobile client): QA Number 50 -> 201 "valid"   (candidate R2W5-C1)
